description: This file defines the MapComparator class, which implements a comparator for Map objects based on specified keys, including support for ascending/descending order. It is used for sorting collections of maps according to specified map keys.

classes.name: MapComparator
classes.description: A comparator for sorting Map objects based on a list of keys, supporting ascending and descending order, and handling null values appropriately.

methods.name: MapComparator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the comparator with a list of keys to sort by.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare MapComparator instances.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two maps based on the specified keys, considering sorting order and null values.
